Question
========
If you have 12 files each containing a 60×40 array, and you sum them all into a new array then divide by 12, what will be the shape of the resulting “composite_data” array?

Answerlist
-----------
* (60, 40)
* (12, 60, 40)
* (60×12, 40)
* (60, 40×12)
* (40, 12)
* (12, 12)

Solution
========
The resulting averaged array retains the same shape, (60, 40).
